verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's first-party developer docs say it ships native Model Context Protocol support, so AI assistants can interact directly with stores, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. The evidence is only a headline-level statement, without setup, auth or tool-scope detail. Missing for 10: documented tool/capability list, authentication and connection setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: WooCommerce includes native support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI assistants and tools to interact directly with WooCommerce stores through a standardized protocol.
